policy: Reserve refinement when a fine grid already meets the ordinary image target. Original pixels, crops, feature criteria and geometry/paper gates remain unchanged. Low mask error alone does not establish successful reconstruction.

gradientDiagnosis.method: Compare the same candidate boundary gradient against the original binary target and a diagnostic copy with only the missing region filled. The real fitting input is unchanged. Distances sample each cubic at 201 parameters; they are approximate centre-to-curve distances at the nominal 100 mm size.

browser.phase: Full scheduling QA before the newly discovered missing-feature notice was fixed. All workflow checks passed; the puppy reconstruction remains unsuccessful.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

matchingPreference.method: Each differently coloured observed pixel pair across the diagonal forces at least one error for identical templates.
